decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core product in the bakery's traditional rye range, has its own product page, and costs little to keep, so management will stay with it.
The premium raisin stollen again won a gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, which the firm displays publicly, so it is a visible flagship that management will defend.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the firm's announced rye direction, and any weak sales can be put down to a short launch period.
The dark barley malt rye bread is a niche variety, but it sits inside the rye line the firm has publicly committed to, so management is likely to give it more time.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line and makes up the seasonal Christmas range, so dropping it would weaken a publicly committed category.
The firm presented the ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece ("neuestes Meisterstück"), a strong public commitment that makes management unwilling to abandon it early.
